subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw support this Claude app-server bridge as a bundled extension with a repository-owned/approved bridge package, require it to ship as an external plugin, or decline this harness architecture?
rationale: The central remaining blocker is not a mechanical repair: it determines the supported distribution, security ownership, dependency provenance, and long-term plugin/core boundary for a large new runtime surface.

options.title: Approve a bundled path with owned provenance
options.body: Sponsor a narrowed bundled design after the bridge package has approved ownership and the persistent-state and auth-boundary defects are repaired.

options.title: Require an external plugin
options.body: Keep core generic and publish the harness plus bridge through the plugin ecosystem using current SDK seams.

options.title: Decline the harness direction
options.body: Retain existing Claude provider and ACP paths rather than adding this additional runtime architecture.

recommendation.title: Approve a bundled path with owned provenance
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrowed bundled design after the bridge package has approved ownership and the persistent-state and auth-boundary defects are repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: The open canonical proposal requests repository-level product sponsorship, and the available related-history context points to this owner for that decision.
